allocator.local20: Reserve exact local known household IDs once, before spreading any remainder.
allocator.remaining145: Sort household IDs; allocate all remaining resolved North/South/West/Fort IDs first within their existing division; select the cell with greatest remaining known capacity, lexical bucket-key tie break. Then allocate the existing unplaced/non-civil pool by the same capacity/tie rule across remaining cells.
allocator.meaning: Exclusive accounting of pre-existing known-house units. The remainder allocator asserts no physical roof, tenancy, source-derived household class or new presence. Class assignment stays reconstructed, as the original quota allocation was.
allocator.source_eligibility: The same official index dwelling_evidence, named-person grades and present/T-1386 criteria used to derive the165 known-house pool; no additional letter-list household is promoted.
allocator.rebuild_policy: This is an authored reviewable proposal tied to input hashes, not an automatically recaptured moving basis.
